image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of two American bison in a grassy field with trees in the background. The primary subject is a large bison on the right, facing left, displaying a massive shoulder hump, dark shaggy fur on the head and forequarters, and lighter brown fur on the hindquarters. A second bison is partially visible on the left edge, showing its rear flank and tail. The lighting is natural daylight.

The eye is visible and appears dark, though partially shadowed by fur.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and nestled within the thick head fur, which is characteristic.
